Cyberpunk third person shooter even better with friends! 10/10
Another similar masterpiece is Arcadegeddon!

[quote] Please consider following my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41005226/]Curation page[/url]. I cover a wide range of genres both paid and unpaid, providing unbiased opinions as well as regular giveaway events.  [/quote]

[h2]Feels uninspired[/h2]
I played it solo, so that could improve the experience, but each level feels the same. The cyberpunk theme is extremely repetitious in the early stages. It may evolve and change over time, but the UI and simply cycling between the abilities and weapons you get felt a little cluttered. At this point in time, I see a lot of these "Developers First Asset" kit which is the polygons being used so widely by many Action Roguelike creators, which frustrates me because they never change it up. 

They frequently cover their faces to hide the aesthetics of the assets, but it does nothing for me when it's still ultimately the same game, the same style and just constantly feeling similar no matter what you kill or what stage you enter.

Would definitely recommend this game, but make sure you bring a couple friends! This third person Roguelike is a blast to play and has a great diversity of weaponry to choose from. There is enough here to fit just about any and every playstyle. The challenge boxes are nice as well and just after every section we were scouring for any loot boxes we could encounter.

It's a very casual arcade style game with beautiful vibrant colors and graphics. My only complaint is the music tends to get a little boring on repeat, so be sure to load your favorite playlist up just to keep the ambiance. It's not the most challenging game out there but before you've permanently leveled up your character with nanites or unlocked some of the weaponry to start with, expect to have a difficult time progressing early on. Overall a fantastic experience and even better with friends.
